description_en: Enables the dataset management service for a cold storage instance
description_zh: 冷存实例开启数据集服务
name: EnableAIDBClusterDatasetService

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the PolarFS cold storage instance that you attach to the dataset management service. Instructions to invoke: Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the API returns InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed (400). Instructions to invoke: Valid ID format description: specifies the accepted prefix families (such as pcs-xxx), separator conventions (hyphen character vs. underscore character), and the corresponding resource types
parameters.help_zh: 数据集管理服务绑定的PolarFs冷存版实例ID。调用说明：『注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed(400)。』。调用说明：有效 ID 格式说明：指明接受的前缀族（如 pcs-xxx）、分隔符约定（连字符 vs 下划线）及对应资源类型
